entities.name: Taluksangay Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Taluksangay Mosque was built by Hadji Abdullah Maas Nuno in 1885 in the Barangay Taluksangay, Zamboanga City, the Philippines. It is the oldest mosque in Zamboanga Peninsula.
